cluster_summary: This cluster comprises vulnerabilities arising from insecure default configurations (e.g., binding to all network interfaces, missing authentication) and improper origin validation in CORS and CSRF protection. Many members expose administrative interfaces or sensitive data by default, while others involve missing allowlists or incorrect string matching that allow cross-origin attacks.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-influenced inputs, resource identities, state values, or configuration described by the member CVEs into the sensitive operation or security boundary described by the member CVEs. Report code paths where the required validation, authorization, isolation, state check, or binding is absent or not connected to the sensitive effect. Confirm that the required guard is enforced on the same source-to-sink path before the sensitive effect. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 2 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should Introduce a configurable allowlist of permitted origins and validate the request Origin against it before setting the header..

mechanism.missing_guard: the required validation, authorization, isolation, state check, or binding is absent or not connected to the sensitive effect
mechanism.name: CORS responses without origin allowlist validation
mechanism.sink_shape: the sensitive operation or security boundary described by the member CVEs
mechanism.source_shape: attacker-influenced inputs, resource identities, state values, or configuration described by the member CVEs
mechanism.typical_fix: Introduce a configurable allowlist of permitted origins and validate the request Origin against it before setting the header.

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Introduce a configurable allowlist of permitted origins and validate the request Origin against it before setting the header.
sub_patterns.name: CORS responses without origin allowlist validation
sub_patterns.root_cause: The server sets the Access-Control-Allow-Origin header to a wildcard or reflects the request Origin without validating against an allowlist.
